principles: Prefer append-only/auditable projections over competing truth sources.
Fail closed only where the story explicitly opted into scope protection; keep legacy stories compatible.
Bind reviewer conclusions to mechanical hashes, not natural-language claims.
Expose user-visible pass/warn/fail status at lifecycle boundaries.
drivers: Must reduce same-file semantic scope drift that B-be27 path gate cannot detect.
Must not break existing active stories or old v1 scope contracts.
Must be testable by CLI/logic smoke tests without external services.

options.name: semantic-gate-with-diff-pack
pros: Builds directly on B-be27 scope contract and lifecycle gate.
Allows v1 backward compatibility and v2 opt-in enforcement.
Gives reviewers a small mechanical context pack instead of full-repo browsing.
cons: TS/JS anchor extraction is heuristic at first.
Requires several command/policy/session surfaces to stay in sync.

options.name: pre-tool-only-blocking
pros: Could stop some writes before they happen for supported providers.
Simple user story when provider hooks exist.
cons: Does not cover providers without hooks or manual edits.
Still does not prove reviewers checked the right hunks.

options.name: reviewer-policy-only
cons: Still relies on natural-language review quality.
Does not mechanically detect semantic drift inside allowed files.

rationale: This option directly closes the path-gate gap while preserving backward compatibility and giving review/test gates mechanical evidence to verify.

preMortem.scenario: False positives block legitimate allowed-file changes.
preMortem.trigger: Anchor extraction cannot recognize a changed hunk or maps it to the wrong symbol.
preMortem.consequence: Stories get stuck in REVIEW/TEST despite valid changes.
preMortem.mitigation: Use local/shadow/enforce semantics, parseFallback output, explicit hunk acknowledgements, and v1 compatibility.

preMortem.scenario: Guard session duplicates owner lease truth.
preMortem.trigger: guard_session_start writes independent ownership state instead of a projection.
preMortem.consequence: session_brief gives conflicting instructions about who may write.
preMortem.mitigation: Store guard status separately as scope protection projection and keep owner lease as write authority.

preMortem.scenario: Reviewer hash binding breaks old stories.
preMortem.trigger: REVIEW→TEST requires diffPackHash for stories with no scope contract.
preMortem.mitigation: Require hash binding only when scope protection exists or story opts into v2 enforcement.

preMortem.scenario: Natural-language pass still bypasses semantic violations.
preMortem.trigger: review_pass_set does not carry or validate diff pack/scope hash metadata.
preMortem.consequence: Reviewer can claim pass without checking the actual hunks.
preMortem.mitigation: Extend review evidence schema and preflight to require current scopeContractHash/diffPackHash/hunk digests for scope-protected stories.
